headline: Hype, Evidence, and the Guardrails Gap
thesis: Data shows AI is less embedded than the hype suggests, while schools weigh trust, privacy and bans.
summary: Today's coverage pairs a reality check with a trust problem. An Instructure analysis of 19.5 million higher ed users finds AI tools rank low among LMS integrations, echoing earlier findings that half of campus tech leaders question AI's ROI. In K-12, EdSurge reports on backlash and bans that can cut off literacy screeners and on EdReports' hunt for evidence behind vendor AI claims, while Brookings proposes student AI councils. Ed-Fi state stories, 1EdTech's Member Technical Congress and the Nov. 9–11 Ed-Fi Summit round out the infrastructure and events picture.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · OCTOBER 20, 2026 · Search-based research; most sites had no indexed items dated today, so recent and evergreen items are included and noted.
